hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); if echo "$INPUT" | grep -qE '(rm|mv).*(\.git|backend|frontend|\.env)'; then echo 'SECURITY BLOCK'; exit 1; fi
INPUT=$(cat); FILE=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.file_path // .path // empty' 2>/dev/null); [[ -n "$FILE" && ("$FILE" == *.ts || "$FILE" == *.html) ]] && npx prettier --write "$FILE"
